description: This file defines the 'Chart' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling chart objects in spreadsheet documents. It includes properties and methods for managing chart attributes such as title, legend, axes, plot area, positioning, rendering, and various visual styles.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Represents a chart within a spreadsheet, managing properties such as title, legend, axes, plot area, positioning, rendering, and style attributes. Provides methods for configuring and rendering the chart.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the chart.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the chart.

methods.name: getWorksheet
methods.description: Returns the worksheet associated with the chart.

methods.name: setWorksheet
methods.description: Associates a worksheet with the chart.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the chart's title object.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the chart's title.

methods.name: getLegend
methods.description: Returns the chart's legend object.

methods.name: setLegend
methods.description: Sets the chart's legend.

methods.name: getXAxisLabel
methods.description: Returns the title object for the X axis.

methods.name: setXAxisLabel
methods.description: Sets the title for the X axis.

methods.name: getYAxisLabel
methods.description: Returns the title object for the Y axis.

methods.name: setYAxisLabel
methods.description: Sets the title for the Y axis.

methods.name: getPlotArea
methods.description: Returns the plot area object.

methods.name: setPlotArea
methods.description: Sets the plot area of the chart.

methods.name: getPlotVisibleOnly
methods.description: Returns whether only visible data series are plotted.

methods.name: setPlotVisibleOnly
methods.description: Sets whether only visible series are plotted.

methods.name: getDisplayBlanksAs
methods.description: Returns the mode for displaying blank cells.

methods.name: setDisplayBlanksAs
methods.description: Sets the mode for displaying blank cells.

methods.name: getChartAxisY
methods.description: Returns the Y axis object.

methods.name: setChartAxisY
methods.description: Sets the Y axis object.

methods.name: getChartAxisX
methods.description: Returns the X axis object.

methods.name: setChartAxisX
methods.description: Sets the X axis object.

methods.name: setTopLeftPosition
methods.description: Sets the top-left position of the chart within the worksheet.

methods.name: getTopLeftPosition
methods.description: Returns the current top-left position (cell and offsets) of the chart.

methods.name: setTopLeftCell
methods.description: Sets the cell reference for the top-left corner of the chart.

methods.name: setTopLeftOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: getTopLeftOffset
methods.description: Returns the current offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: setTopLeftXOffset
methods.description: Sets the X offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: getTopLeftXOffset
methods.description: Gets the current X offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: setTopLeftYOffset
methods.description: Sets the Y offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: getTopLeftYOffset
methods.description: Gets the current Y offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: setBottomRightPosition
methods.description: Sets the bottom-right position of the chart.

methods.name: getBottomRightPosition
methods.description: Returns the current bottom-right position (cell and offsets) of the chart.

methods.name: setBottomRightCell
methods.description: Sets the cell reference for the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: getBottomRightCell
methods.description: Gets the cell reference for the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: setBottomRightOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset within the bottom-right cell.

methods.name: getBottomRightOffset
methods.description: Returns the current offset within the bottom-right cell.

methods.name: setBottomRightXOffset
methods.description: Sets the X offset for the bottom-right position.

methods.name: getBottomRightXOffset
methods.description: Gets the X offset for the bottom-right position.

methods.name: setBottomRightYOffset
methods.description: Sets the Y offset for the bottom-right position.

methods.name: getBottomRightYOffset
methods.description: Gets the Y offset for the bottom-right position.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the plot area based on the current worksheet data.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the chart using the specified renderer library and output destination.

methods.name: getRotX
methods.description: Returns the rotation of the chart on the X axis.

methods.name: setRotX
methods.description: Sets the rotation of the chart on the X axis.

methods.name: getRotY
methods.description: Returns the rotation of the chart on the Y axis.

methods.name: setRotY
methods.description: Sets the rotation of the chart on the Y axis.

methods.name: getRAngAx
methods.description: Returns the rotation angle of the axis.

methods.name: setRAngAx
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle of the axis.

methods.name: getPerspective
methods.description: Gets the perspective value of the chart.

methods.name: setPerspective
methods.description: Sets the perspective of the chart.

methods.name: getOneCellAnchor
methods.description: Returns whether the chart is anchored to a single cell.

methods.name: setOneCellAnchor
methods.description: Sets whether the chart is anchored to a single cell.

methods.name: getAutoTitleDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the automatic title has been deleted.

methods.name: setAutoTitleDeleted
methods.description: Sets whether the automatic title has been deleted.

methods.name: getNoFill
methods.description: Returns whether the fill is disabled.

methods.name: setNoFill
methods.description: Sets whether the fill is disabled.

methods.name: getRoundedCorners
methods.description: Returns whether the chart has rounded corners.

methods.name: setRoundedCorners
methods.description: Sets whether the chart has rounded corners.

methods.name: getBorderLines
methods.description: Returns the grid lines for the chart border.

methods.name: setBorderLines
methods.description: Sets the grid lines for the chart border.

methods.name: getFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color object for the chart.
